guarantees.name: Limited Lifetime Warranty
guarantees.text: Your window treatments will come with a manufacturers limited lifetime warranty. Any factory defects found in your treatments are covered for life.

guarantees.name: Apples-to-Apples
guarantees.text: We believe in our pricing and want you to have peace of mind doing business with us. That's why we offer an apples-to-apples price-match guarantee.

guarantees.name: Our GuaranTEN
guarantees.text: For every ten window treatments you purchase, we'll replace one window treatment for free. Break it, don't like it, get tired of it, we'll replace it, no questions asked.

guarantees.name: Here-4-You
guarantees.text: We offer a 4-Year Service Guarantee. If you have any issues with your window treatments, we'll come out and service your blinds, shades, or shutters at no cost.

guarantees.name: Transferable Warranty
guarantees.text: Whether you're in your forever home or not, buying through Love Is Blinds gives you peace of mind. Our warranties transfer if you sell your home.
